# Figure setup
```{r figure-setup}
method_labels <- c(
  "Backward p-value" = "Backward",
  "Backward AIC" = "AIC",
  "Backward BIC" = "BIC",
  "LASSO: lambda.min" = "LASSO min",
  "LASSO: lambda.1se" = "LASSO 1se",
  "Elastic net: lambda.min" = "EN min",
  "Elastic net: lambda.1se" = "EN 1se"
)

plot_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )
```




```{r figure1-selection-heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=7.5}
# Figure 1: Selection accuracy and false discovery heatmap

figure1_data <- method_performance %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
    Method = factor(
      Method,
      levels = c(
        "Backward",
        "AIC",
        "BIC",
        "LASSO 1se",
        "LASSO min",
        "EN 1se",
        "EN min"
      )
    ),
    Scenario = paste0("N = ", sample_size, ", ρ = ", rho),
    Scenario = factor(
      Scenario,
      levels = c(
        "N = 250, ρ = 0",
        "N = 250, ρ = 0.35",
        "N = 250, ρ = 0.7",
        "N = 500, ρ = 0",
        "N = 500, ρ = 0.35",
        "N = 500, ρ = 0.7"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Scenario,
    Method,
    `True Positive Rate\nhigher is better` = mean_true_positive_rate,
    `False Positive Rate\nlower is better` = mean_false_positive_rate
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      `True Positive Rate\nhigher is better`,
      `False Positive Rate\nlower is better`
    ),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = c(
        "True Positive Rate\nhigher is better",
        "False Positive Rate\nlower is better"
      )
    )
  )

figure1 <- ggplot(
  figure1_data,
  aes(
    x = Method,
    y = Scenario,
    fill = Value
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Value)),
    size = 3.3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, ncol = 2) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "white",
    high = "#2C7FB8",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Rate"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1. Selection Accuracy and False Discovery Across Methods",
    subtitle = "Each cell shows the average rate across 10,000 simulations per scenario; higher TPR and lower FPR indicate better selection performance.",
    x = "Selection Method",
    y = "Simulation Scenario",
    caption = "TPR = proportion of true predictors selected. FPR = proportion of null predictors incorrectly selected."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

figure1

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_folder, "Figure1_Selection_Accuracy_Heatmap.png"),
  plot = figure1,
  width = 12,
  height = 7.5,
  dpi = 300
)
```








```{r figure1-tradeoff, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.5}
fig1_data <- method_performance %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
    sample_size_label = paste0("N = ", sample_size),
    rho_label = paste0("rho = ", rho)
  )

fig1 <- ggplot(
  fig1_data,
  aes(
    x = mean_false_positive_rate,
    y = mean_true_positive_rate,
    color = Method,
    shape = rho_label
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_size_label) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, NA), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1. Trade-off Between True Positive Rate and False Positive Rate",
    subtitle = "Upper-left region indicates better selection performance",
    x = "Mean False Positive Rate",
    y = "Mean True Positive Rate",
    shape = "Correlation"
  ) +
  plot_theme

fig1

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_folder, "Figure1_TPR_FPR_Tradeoff.png"),
  plot = fig1,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Main Figure 2
### Variable-Level Power for Truly Associated Predictors

This figure shows how often each true predictor \(X_1\)–\(X_5\) was selected across simulation settings.



```{r figure2-weak-signal, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
figure2_data <- by_variable %>%
  filter(variable == "X1") %>%
  group_by(sample_size, rho, method, variable, beta_true) %>%
  summarize(
    selection_probability = mean(chosen),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
    Method = factor(
      Method,
      levels = c(
        "Backward",
        "AIC",
        "BIC",
        "LASSO 1se",
        "LASSO min",
        "EN 1se",
        "EN min"
      )
    ),
    sample_size_label = paste0("N = ", sample_size)
  )

figure2 <- ggplot(
  figure2_data,
  aes(
    x = factor(rho),
    y = selection_probability,
    color = Method,
    group = Method
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_size_label) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2. Selection Probability for the Weakest Signal",
    subtitle = expression("Predictor X1 has the smallest nonzero effect (" * beta[1] == 0.1667 * "); differences among methods are most visible for weak signals."),
    x = expression("Predictor Correlation (" * rho * ")"),
    y = "Selection Probability",
    caption = "Each point shows the proportion of 10,000 simulations in which X1 was selected."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

figure2

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_folder, "Figure2_Weak_Signal_X1_Selection.png"),
  plot = figure2,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```





```{r figure3-coverage, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.5}
overall_inference_summary <- by_variable %>%
  group_by(sample_size, rho, method) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_type_I_error = mean(type_I_error[beta_true == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_type_II_error = mean(type_II_error[beta_true != 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bias_signal_variables = mean(unconditional_bias[beta_true != 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_coverage_signal_variables = mean(ci_covers_truth[beta_true != 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fig3_data <- overall_inference_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
    sample_size_label = paste0("N = ", sample_size)
  )

fig3 <- ggplot(
  fig3_data,
  aes(
    x = factor(rho),
    y = mean_coverage_signal_variables,
    color = Method,
    group = Method
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.95,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_size_label) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 3. Empirical Coverage Probability for Truly Associated Predictors",
    
    subtitle =
      "Coverage was evaluated for predictors with nonzero regression coefficients (X1–X5). The dashed line represents 
    nominal 95% confidence interval coverage after variable selection and post-selection OLS refitting.",

    x = expression("Predictor Correlation (" * rho * ")"),

    y = "Mean Coverage Probability",

    caption =
      "Coverage probabilities below 0.95 indicate undercoverage and reduced inferential reliability."
  ) +
  plot_theme +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

fig3

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_folder,
    "Figure3_Coverage_Probability.png"
  ),
  plot = fig3,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.8,
  dpi = 300
)
```


```{r appendix-figure-a1-bias, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
figure4_bias_data <- by_variable %>%
  filter(variable %in% signal_variables) %>%
  group_by(sample_size, rho, method, variable, beta_true) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_bias = mean(unconditional_bias, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),

    Method = factor(
      Method,
      levels = c(
        "Backward",
        "AIC",
        "BIC",
        "LASSO 1se",
        "LASSO min",
        "EN 1se",
        "EN min"
      )
    ),

    sample_size_label = paste0("N = ", sample_size),

    rho_label = factor(
      paste0("ρ = ", rho),
      levels = c(
        "ρ = 0",
        "ρ = 0.35",
        "ρ = 0.7"
      )
    ),

    variable_label = paste0(
      variable,
      "\nβ = ",
      round(beta_true, 3)
    )
  )

figure4 <- ggplot(
  figure4_bias_data,
  aes(
    x = variable_label,
    y = mean_bias,
    color = Method,
    group = Method
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  facet_grid(
    rho_label ~ sample_size_label
  ) +
  labs(
    title =
      "Figure 4. Variable-Level Unconditional Bias for Truly Associated Predictors",

    subtitle =
      "Bias was evaluated for predictors with nonzero regression coefficients (X1–X5). More negative values indicate downward bias caused by shrinkage 
    or failure to select weaker signals after variable selection.",

    x =
      "True Predictor and Corresponding Regression Coefficient",

    y =
      "Mean Unconditional Bias",

    caption =
      "Bias was computed after variable selection and post-selection OLS refitting. Results are averaged over 10,000 simulation replicates for each scenario."
  ) +
  plot_theme +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 9,
      hjust = 0
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

figure4

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    figure_folder,
    "Figure4_Variable_Level_Bias.png"
  ),
  plot = figure4,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```


## Appendix Figure A2: Type I error heatmap

```{r appendix-figure-a2-typeI, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
appendix_typeI_data <- by_variable %>%
  filter(variable %in% noise_variables) %>%
  group_by(sample_size, rho, method) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_type_I_error = mean(type_I_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(method, !!!method_labels),
    sample_size_label = paste0("N = ", sample_size),
    rho_label = paste0("rho = ", rho)
  )

appendix_fig_A2 <- ggplot(
  appendix_typeI_data,
  aes(
    x = Method,
    y = rho_label,
    fill = mean_type_I_error
  )
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", mean_type_I_error)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_size_label) +
  labs(
    title = "Appendix Figure A2. Type I Error for Null Predictors",
    x = "Method",
    y = expression(rho),
    fill = "Type I Error"
  ) +
  plot_theme

appendix_fig_A2

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_folder, "Appendix_Figure_A2_TypeI_Error.png"),
  plot = appendix_fig_A2,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```
